name: persistent-shell
description: Reusable SSH shell sessions from Windows through a user-level local daemon.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse stateful SSH shell sessions from Windows.
interface.longDescription: Start and reuse non-interactive SSH shell channels across PowerShell and Git Bash commands, preserving remote working directory and shell state while avoiding repeated connection startup.
defaultPrompt: Use the persistent shell workflow for repeated commands on this SSH target.
